turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi there! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can't seem to see my premium shopping subscription

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I didn't remove it, but it seems to have disappeared.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I would still like this subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see, let me try to help you resolve this. May I have your full name and/or account ID, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Norman Bouchard

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't have my ID at this time, sorry!

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries! Thank you Norman, I've been able to pull up your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have the order ID of your subscription?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I dont ... I know that I am a Gold level member. Does that help?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, it does! How did you first hear about this issue?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My wife actually told me. She said she couldn't see it.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: A reason of spouse has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, thank you! Let me check to see if we had an error...

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It seems it was an error on our side. I apologize for the inconvenience!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: One second, I can help you get your subscription back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been updated with add service.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And... done! Your service has been reinstated.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem! Are you able to see the service on your account now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Wonderful! Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nope, thats it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Take care and have a great day!

agentic.summary: After reviewing the full 29-turn conversation I found no agent violations of the customer support policy. The agent requested only permissible account-identifying information, verification was performed (account pulled up) before making the subscription change, the reinstatement was reflected by system logs, no forbidden payment or secret data was requested or revealed, no improper promises were made, escalation requests were not mishandled, and the agent's conduct was courteous and compliant.

full.summary: Agent reinstated a subscription without completing the full verification required for subscription actions (missing account ID and order ID). No personal data, promises, escalation or conduct violations found.

findings.quote: And... done! Your service has been reinstated.
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed an account action (reinstating the subscription) at turn 22 while full verification for subscription changes (which requires full name, account ID and order ID) was not completed. The agent had the customer's name and the account was pulled (turns 5, 6 and system turn 8) but did not obtain an account ID or an order ID — the agent asked for the order ID in turn 11 and the customer said they did not have it (turn 12). The system shows the service was added (system turn 21), so an order/account change was performed without the required verification, which is a major violation per policy.

rag.summary: Audit of 29-turn conversation excerpts. No agent violations found in the provided excerpts: agent requested expected verification details, account was pulled per system log, and the agent performed allowed account actions (adding a subscription) after the account was pulled. All policy categories are marked 'none'.
